title: Revisit parked W1 Foundation blockers before further master data
purpose: Classify parked W1 Foundation blockers after TARGET-037: General Posting Setup Page 314, VAT Posting Setup, Inventory Posting Setup, global/default dimensions, U-ITEM numbering and vendor numbering.
entryCriteria: TARGET-037 classified Location and Customer as basic proven records.
Preview Posting and Posting remain false.
acceptanceCriteria: Each parked Foundation blocker is classified as solve-next, park-with-boundary, needs-ui-discovery-first, or blocked.
Exactly one next Foundation case is selected.
No live Business Central or Playwright action occurs in this review case.
No setup or master data is changed.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-037 proves only SAAR-HL and U-CUST-100 as basic records. Vendor, item, VAT, General Posting Setup, Inventory Posting Setup, documents, Preview and Posting remain unproven.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: A direct item write would skip item/inventory setup discovery. The next better step is read-only preflight of item and inventory Foundation pages.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Inspects Base Units, Item Posting Groups, Inventory Posting Setup, Inventory Setup and U-ITEM assignment without writing data.
Wait until TARGET-040 proves which item fields and setup dependencies are safe.
Useful after the item/inventory preflight updates the blocker map.
O2C needs item, posting groups, VAT and expected posting trace boundaries.
Vendor remains blocked until U-VEND Manual Nos. has a new non-repeated route.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It preserves W1 Foundation order and gathers the missing page/field evidence needed before the first item write.
risksBeforeNextCase: Read-only page inspection must not become setup or item creation.
Do not accept search-overlay screenshots as page proof.
Do not claim inventory posting readiness from page visibility alone.
requiredPreparation: Confirm playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE before any read-only UI navigation.
Capture page context, key fields and screenshot QA for each inspected item/inventory setup page.

blockerClassification.reason: No trusted Page 314 write/card route exists after tested UI routes. INLAND and WAREN are prerequisite groups, but the INLAND/WAREN/4400/5400 matrix row is not proven.
blockerClassification.nextHandling: Do not retry Page 314 until a materially new card/action/personalization/source-backed UI route exists.

blockerClassification.reason: The VAT matrix route is deliberately parked; no correct INLAND/VAT19 VAT Posting Setup row, no 19 percent VAT proof, no VAT Entries and no German VAT final claim are proven.
blockerClassification.nextHandling: Keep VAT claims and Preview/Post locked; revisit only with a new non-repeating standard route.

blockerClassification.blocker: Inventory Posting Setup and item foundation
blockerClassification.reason: Item creation is the tempting next write, but item fields affect Base Unit, Item Type, posting groups, inventory setup and later value entries. This area has not had a dedicated read-only preflight after TARGET-037.
blockerClassification.nextHandling: Run a read-only preflight for Inventory Setup, Inventory Posting Setup, item posting groups, base units and U-ITEM setup assignment before any item write.

blockerClassification.reason: PRODUCTLINE, COSTCENTER and CHANNEL plus starter values are visible, but global dimension assignments and default dimensions are not proven.
blockerClassification.nextHandling: Default dimensions wait for concrete master data; global dimensions need a separate route and must not be claimed from TARGET-033.

blockerClassification.reason: U-VEND Manual Nos. is not proven active after reopen, and repeated checkbox/list routes are explicitly rejected.
blockerClassification.nextHandling: Do not retry first vendor until a genuinely new non-repeated number-series route exists.

blockerClassification.reason: Only one customer and one location are proven. No item, vendor, posting matrix, VAT matrix, inventory setup or expected entry trace is proven.
blockerClassification.nextHandling: Keep documents, Preview Posting and Posting locked until Foundation and first item/vendor gates are clean.
